name: Can I use chemical drain cleaners to clear a clogged bathroom sink?

mainEntity.name: Can I use chemical drain cleaners to clear a clogged bathroom sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: While chemical drain cleaners can sometimes clear minor clogs, they often contain harsh chemicals that can damage pipes over time, especially older or PVC plumbing. They can also be dangerous if not used properly and may not fully clear stubborn blockages. For persistent clogs, professional snaking is a safer and more effective solution offered by CG Plumbing Solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Chemical drain cleaners can damage pipes and may not be effective. Professional snaking is a safer alternative.
